$comment: Test fixture exercising all fields of the Singapore / Malaysia extension schema

shareSchedule.notes: Spouse receives half under ISA Rule 2 where there are children but no parents
Remaining half divided equally among surviving children under ISA Rule 2

singaporeISA.notes: Non-Muslim intestate distribution under the Intestate Succession Act (Cap. 146). Applicable because the deceased was not a Muslim and died without a valid will.

singaporeAMLA.faraidRef: N/A — deceased was not Muslim; included for completeness
singaporeAMLA.notes: AMLA (Administration of Muslim Law Act) distribution does not apply. The Shafi'i school is the default in Singapore for Muslim estates.

cpfNominations.notes: CPF nomination made under the CPF (Nominations) Rules. Both children nominated in equal shares. Nomination is binding and overrides intestate rules for CPF moneys.
Supplementary Retirement Scheme (SRS) account nomination to spouse.

shareSchedule.notes: Under the Distribution Act 1958, where deceased leaves spouse and children

malaysianDistributionAct.notes: Malaysian Distribution Act 1958 does not apply — deceased was domiciled in Singapore. Share schedule included for reference only.

malaysianShariah.shariaCourtReference: N/A — no Shariah court jurisdiction for this estate
malaysianShariah.notes: Shariah court jurisdiction applies only to Muslim estates in Malaysia. Included for completeness as the extension covers both jurisdictions.

epfNominations.notes: Malaysian EPF nomination — non-binding for non-Muslim members. EPF moneys distributed per nomination as trustee, not as beneficiary.
Second EPF account nomination, single nominee.

notes: Fictional estate of Lim Mei Hua, deceased 12 September 2025 in Singapore. Non-Muslim Singaporean citizen. Two adult children and surviving spouse. CPF nominations in place; no valid will found.

x-inherit-hdbFlat.value: 4-room HDB flat at Toa Payoh — subject to HDB resale eligibility rules on succession

x-inherit-insuranceNominations.value: Two NTUC Income policies with irrevocable nominations to children
